result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security v2.4.1

disclosed_matters.summary: Incorrect jurisdiction of incorporation information in one EV certificate.
Unconstrained ICA certificates were not revoked in 7 days.
Discussion of procedures for revocation of certificates with compromised private keys.
A single EV certificate was identified with an inappropriate JOI serialNumber with 'none' value.
QuoVadis had not responded to a complaint within 24 hours; dialogue was ongoing at the time.
Incorrect OCSP Delegated Responder Certificate affecting hundreds of issuing CAs across the industry.
Failure to revoke ICAs identified in OCSP EKU issue within 7 days.
A single TLS certificate was identified with inappropriate keyUsage for ECC certificate.
